label: Test by the degree-indexed induction controls of nothing moves except as in act
note: The coil moves the workpiece from cold to hot in the heat respects. The formal (IN_ACT_1) reading of the premise fails at the degree-indexed respect (heat at or above the workpiece's degree), which the coil lacks formally; at the respect of having some heat the coil has heat formally and that instance holds. The inclusive (IN_ACT_3) reading holds. By DISAMB-IN-ACT the prima via then needs non-simultaneity on the inclusive reading, where the Metaphysics IX.6 support, given for formal act, does not carry over.
